## Houston 1.0.0

Houston 1.0 is here, and Houston is out of beta. Thank you for building it with us.

### Plans, and a gift for our beta testers

- **Plans start on October 1, 2026.** Your plan is personal and covers you in every space.
- **Free is for personal use.** It has a weekly usage limit, shown as a percentage of your week. Houston lets you know as you get close, and if you reach the limit it tells you when your usage resets.
- **On Free, one routine runs at a time, at most every 15 minutes.** If you have several, you choose the one to keep running. The others stay saved.
- **On Free, routines pause after 7 days away.** When you come back, Houston asks if you want to resume them.
- **Plus is USD 15 a month with our launch discount, down from USD 20.** You keep going without waiting, all your routines run, and they keep running while you are away.
- **Teams is coming soon**, so your whole team can work on Houston together.
- **A thank-you gift for our beta testers.** If your account was created before October 1, 2026 and you have never had Plus, your first month of Plus is USD 10. Then it is USD 15 a month. There is no deadline.
- **A new Billing screen in Settings** shows your plan, your weekly usage, your routines and your invoices. Upgrade or manage your payment from there.

### Meet Houston, your AI Manager

- **Your AI Manager is named Houston.** It builds your team, hands out the work and keeps track of it.
- **New to Houston? It welcomes you in its own chat.** It helps you connect your AI, asks a few questions about your work and builds a starter team with you. Then it takes your first goal and you watch it pick who does what and get started.
- **AI Employees give each other missions.** A Teamwork setting on each one decides who it gives missions to and who it takes them from. Every mission shows who started it, including "Started by Houston".
- **Houston can do more for you**: connect your apps and your AI through secure cards, rename missions and find your past chats.
- **Talk to Houston from Slack.** Connect it in Settings > Channels and continue the same conversation in the app.

### A new home for your team

- **The sidebar is your team.** It lists Houston and your AI Employees, with "Connect your apps" and "Connect your AI" at the bottom. Your account menu holds your spaces, Profile, Admin, the Academy and Settings.
- **Groups replace teams.** Arrange your AI Employees into your own groups with drag and drop. Your arrangement is yours and never changes anyone else's.
- **Admin opens on your org chart**, with the hours your AI Employees worked this month, who ranks first, and who manages or uses each one.
- **Pick your colors.** Settings > Appearance offers Light, Dark or System, plus a palette for each mode that you see change live.
- **On Mac, the title bar blends into the sidebar** for a cleaner window.

### AI Employees that learn your work

- **Hiring starts from an industry and a role**, picked from a catalog you can search, then a name and a color.
- **A new AI Employee starts with a first day.** It introduces itself, offers three concrete jobs, does one with you on a real case and saves it as a Skill.
- **Skills read as workflows**: numbered steps you edit in each AI Employee's settings.
- **GPT-6 Luna is the default ChatGPT model.**

### Work and routines you can count on

- **If Houston restarts in the middle of a task, the task picks up once on its own**, and your AI Employee tells you what carried over.
- **A routine that keeps failing for the same reason pauses itself** after 10 tries and tells you the one fix, like reconnecting an account.
- **A routine that has run for a long time keeps running**, instead of failing once its chat grows too long.
- **Routine history keeps every run**, even when several run at the same time.
- **The routine screen shows the model the routine runs.**
- **A routine your AI Employee sets up runs on the same AI as the chat it came from.**
- **Replies start sooner.**

### Fixes and polish

- **A folder Houston cannot write to says so**, instead of failing in silence.
- **After Houston summarizes a long chat, you see the reply**, not the summary.
- **Connecting a model that runs on your own computer saves correctly.**
- **Signing in on a computer with no default browser** tells you what to do.
- **An update download retries a short hiccup** on its own.
- **On Windows, a missing WebView2 is named**, with the fix.
- **A folder name with a space in it** no longer blocks your AI Employee's commands.
- Additional reliability improvements under the hood.

### Before you upgrade

- Quit Houston before installing. macOS doesn't always replace a running app. If in doubt, delete Houston from Applications and drag the new copy in.
- On Free with more than one routine, Houston asks you to choose the one to keep running. The others stay saved.
- Your teams become groups with the same AI Employees. Team pages and team notes are retired.
- An AI Employee already named "Houston" keeps its name. New ones can't take it.
- Some things moved or are retired: the Agent Store and the skills marketplace leave the app, the help menu is gone (Report bug stays in Settings), and the tour is two lessons in the Academy.

### Known limitations

- Teams is not available yet.
- Slack appears in Settings only where your Houston is set up for it.
